refinement_plan_1:
Analysis of Review Feedback (Iteration 1):

High Priority:
- CQ5 (Organization participant details): Ontology lacks explicit properties for detailed participant info (contact details, legal name, registration info). Add new data properties to Organization: legalName, registrationNumber, contactEmail, contactPhone, vatNumber.
- CQ8 (Item details): Ontology lacks detailed properties for Item (description, SKU, unit of measure). Add new data properties to Item: itemDescription, sku, unitOfMeasure, brand, manufacturer.

Medium Priority:
- Quality: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and owl:equivalentClass for InvoiceMessage, DetailSection, RoleAssignment to clarify necessary and sufficient conditions. E.g., InvoiceMessage ≡ Message and hasSection some HeaderSection and hasSection some DetailSection and hasSection some SummarySection.
- Quality: Add explicit union/disjoint union axioms for Section subclasses (HeaderSection, DetailSection, SummarySection).

Low Priority:
- Optional enrichment: Add temporal properties (effectiveDate, dueDate) using xsd:dateTime for invoices and line items.

Constraint Adherence:
- Preserve all existing OWL 2 DL constraints, property characteristics, reification structure, and annotations.
- Do not remove or break any current CQ coverage.

Plan:
1. Add new data properties to Organization and Item for missing CQ5 and CQ8 coverage.
2. Add GCAs/equivalentClass axioms for InvoiceMessage, DetailSection, RoleAssignment.
3. Add union/disjoint union axioms for Section subclasses.
4. Optionally, add temporal properties (effectiveDate, dueDate) if time permits.
5. Validate syntax and check for OOPS pitfalls after refinement.
